How people read you (and get it wrong)
What your elements do to your face and fit
Your colours, worked out from your chart

The small details that make it yours
When your aura dims, and the reset

plan2.title: Your aura, before you say a word

vibe.speaker: bom
vibe.text: Your vibe first, you said. Good. Your vibe walks in two seconds before you do.

style.speaker: yeon
style.text: Style first. Great. I'll tell you what's working and what's a costume.

calm.speaker: bom
calm.text: "That I have it together." We can do that. And actually mean it, not just look it.

unsaid.speaker: yeon
unsaid.text: You didn't say what people should notice. They're noticing anyway. Let's control the narrative.

strong.text:
Yeon: Strong chart. Your aura is turned up loud by default. People feel you before they see you.

Bom: That's presence. Not everyone has it.

Yeon: Not everyone has to stand next to it at a party, either.

Your glow-up isn't adding more. It's one soft thing that lets people in: a warmer colour near your face, a smile before you speak.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Your aura is already at full volume. Find the dimmer.

weak.text:
Bom: Your chart runs soft. Your aura is gentle. People feel calm near you before they notice you.

Yeon: Which means they sometimes don't notice you. Rude of them. Also fixable.

Bom: Your glow-up is one strong anchor: a colour, a piece, a signature that says "I'm here".

Pick one thing people will remember you by and wear it on purpose for a month.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Soft auras glow with one strong anchor. Pick yours.

base.aura:
Before you speak, people sense direction. This person knows where they're going and has a plan for getting there.

Bom: It's the aura of the friend everyone calls when the group trip falls apart.

Yeon: It's also slightly intimidating. People don't flirt with someone who looks mid-meeting.

Bom: The glow-up is in your face, not your clothes. Unclench the jaw. Smile first.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: Your aura is tall-tree. People feel safe the second you walk in.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: They also feel like they're about to be assigned a task.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: Upright, clear, dependable. You look like someone with a plan, because you are.

spring.intro: Spring birthday. That's tree season, so you got a double shot of yourself: taller, louder, surer. In saju terms, Wood ran the month you were born in. In real life, you've never once waited to be picked.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Double Wood. So the stubbornness is seasonal AND personal. Great.

summer.intro: You're a tree born in the heat. All that growing goes straight into showing: big plans, big talk, big gestures. Summer burns through a pine fast, so you look unstoppable right up until you suddenly need three days in bed.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You give off so much light. Just save a little for yourself.

autumn.intro: Autumn is axe season, and you're the tree. Life started trimming you early: rules, pressure, people with opinions. It made you sharper and more disciplined than other pines. It also made you allergic to being told what to do.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Pruned young. Explains the posture. And the attitude.

winter.intro: A winter pine. The cold kept you quiet on the outside while the roots drank everything. You think longer than you let on, and when you finally move, it's because you already decided weeks ago.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You look calm. Underneath, you've been planning since November.

earth.intro: Born in the between-season weeks, when soil runs the show. For a tree, that means work: you're always building, fixing, providing. Very useful. Very tired. Somebody should ask what you want for once.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Rest is not a prize you win. It's allowed.

three-words.heading: Your aura in three words, plus its evil twin
three-words.text:
Good days: upright, certain, protective.

Tired days: rigid, impatient, closed.

Yeon: Same tree. Different weather. The difference isn't your outfit. It's whether your shoulders are up by your ears.

Before something important, three slow breaths. Drop the shoulders. The shelter comes back.

open.title: You look like you know where the fire exit is. Because you do.
open.text:
You stand straight. You walk with purpose. Strangers ask you for directions in cities you've never visited.

Bom: You radiate dependable.

Yeon: You radiate "head of the residents' committee". We can soften it.
open.end: Yeon: Next page: your aura before you speak. And the one word people would never say out loud.

cliff.text: Yeon: How people read you, Pine: they think you're | unapproachable. You're not. You just look like you're about to correct someone.

sample.text: Your glow-up isn't more structure. It's one soft thing near your face. Yes, one. I'm being generous.

base.aura:
Your aura is the climbing flower: soft lines, a warm face, an easy grace. Strangers relax before you've even said hello.

Bom: You make everyone comfortable.

Yeon: You also copy the vibe of whoever you're with. Goth friend, goth you. Gym friend, suddenly leggings.

Bom: Your glow-up is one look that stays yours, whatever room you're in.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: Your aura is a flower in bloom. Soft, warm, people lean toward you.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: And then they tell you their life story at a bus stop. Every time.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: Graceful, adaptable, a bit romantic. You look like someone people want to know.

spring.intro: Spring birthday for the vine. Everything around you was growing, so you learned to grow toward whatever held still long enough. Charming. Flexible. Absolutely capable of getting your way while people believe they chose it.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Double Wood vine. You don't push. You wrap. Same result.

summer.intro: A flower in full sun. You bloom in public: the outfit, the story, the laugh across the room. The cost is that you wilt on the inside when nobody's watering you, and you'd rather die than ask.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You're so easy to love. You just don't always let anyone try.

autumn.intro: Autumn is cutting season, and you're the soft stem. You grew up reading rooms for danger, learning who's sharp and how to bend before they swing. That's why you're so good with people. It's also why you apologise to furniture.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You flinch at "can we talk" like it's a fire alarm.

winter.intro: A winter flower. Cold outside, so you grew inward: rich head, private feelings, a whole inner world nobody gets the password to. When you trust someone, it's total. Getting there takes a season.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Your inside is so much warmer than you let people see.

earth.intro: Born in the weeks between seasons, when the soil takes over. For a vine, that means you grow by managing things: schedules, people, plans. You're the reason the group trip happened. Nobody thanked you properly.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Unpaid project manager of every friendship. Since birth.

three-words.heading: Your aura in three words, plus its evil twin
three-words.text:
Good days: graceful, warm, inviting.

Tired days: blurry, eager, borrowed.

Yeon: "Borrowed" is the one to watch. When you dress for the room instead of you, the glow goes.

Keep one signature piece on, whoever you're meeting. It's an anchor.

open.title: Strangers tell you their whole life story at bus stops. It's the aura.
open.text:
You walk into a room and people relax. You look approachable, gentle, interesting. Somebody's grandmother has definitely tried to set you up.

Bom: You're magnetic in a soft way.

Yeon: You're magnetic in a "can I borrow your charger and also your emotional support" way.
open.end: Yeon: Next page: your aura, and the version of it that disappears when you're trying too hard to fit in.

cliff.text: Yeon: How people read you, Flower: they think you're | sweet and easy to steer. They're half right, and the other half surprises them.

sample.text: Your glow-up: stop dressing for the room. Dress for the version of you who doesn't ask "is this okay?"

base.aura:
Your aura is the sun: bright, warm, wide open. People feel invited the second you smile.

Bom: You make everyone feel like they're at the party.

Yeon: You also turn up looking like the party. Sometimes the room wanted a quieter guest.

Bom: Your glow-up is contrast. One calm, simple piece makes all that light look intentional.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: Your aura is sunshine. You walk in and the room gets warmer.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: People can hear you laugh from the car park. It's a feature.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: Bright, open, generous. You look like the best night out anyone's had.

spring.intro: The sun, born in spring. Everything was feeding you: new leaves, longer days, people who wanted your attention. So you grew up assuming warmth is normal. When someone's cold to you, it genuinely confuses you.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Rooms get brighter when you arrive. That is not nothing.

summer.intro: The sun at noon in July. Double fire. You don't enter rooms, you arrive. Generous, loud, impossible to ignore, and secretly a little hurt every time someone doesn't notice you lit the place up.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Main character, sequel, director's cut. All you.

autumn.intro: An autumn sun. Lower in the sky, aimed at things: harvest, goals, results. You're warm, but you're also counting. You notice exactly who showed up for you and who just liked the post.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Warm and keeping score. Your sunshine comes with receipts.

winter.intro: A winter sun. Short days, cold air, people who needed you more than they could give back. It made you tough and a little performative: the brightest one in the room, even on the days you're running on fumes.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You shine hardest when you're the most tired. I see it.

earth.intro: Born in the between-season weeks, when Earth runs things. For the sun, that means everything you give turns into something solid: a friend's confidence, a plan that worked, a party you made happen. You're a great investment. Ask what you're getting back.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You fund everyone's glow-up and forget to invoice.

three-words.heading: Your aura in three words, plus its evil twin
three-words.text:
Good days: radiant, generous, magnetic.

Tired days: loud, scattered, performing.

Yeon: "Performing" is when you're bright for them, not for you. People can feel the difference.

On flat days, don't force the shine. A quiet outfit and a real smile beat a forced sparkle.

open.title: You don't have an indoor voice. You have a stage voice and a smaller stage voice.
open.text:
You light up rooms. Your laugh carries. People find you in a crowd without trying because you're the brightest thing in it.

Bom: Your warmth is visible.

Yeon: Your warmth is visible from space. Let's talk about when to dim it.
open.end: Yeon: Next page: your aura, plus the moment it tips from "glowing" into "a lot".

cliff.text: Yeon: How people read you, Sun: they think you're | always happy. So nobody checks on you. That's the cost of shining for a living.

sample.text: Your glow-up: one calm piece in every outfit. Let the light look like a choice, not a fire alarm.

base.aura:
Your aura is candlelight: small, warm, intense. People feel it most in one-to-one moments.

Bom: When you pay attention, people feel like the only person there.

Yeon: Across a room, though, you can read as cold. You're not cold. You're conserving.

Bom: Your glow-up is warmth you can see from a distance: a colour near your face, a smile you send first.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: Your aura is candlelight. Warm, intimate, people lean in to hear you.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: You look like you're keeping a beautiful secret. Usually you're just hungry.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: Soft glow, deep eyes, a focused warmth. People feel chosen when you look at them.

spring.intro: A candle lit in spring. Fed from every side, so your warmth is steady and close: one person, one conversation, the whole night. You'd take a deep two-hour talk over a party of fifty every single time.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: When you pay attention to someone, they feel chosen.

summer.intro: A candle in midsummer. Double fire, so the flame runs hot: intense focus, intense loyalty, intense feelings you insist are "fine". You don't do half anything. That includes holding a grudge.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You remember a tone of voice from 2019. Word for word.

autumn.intro: A candle in autumn, burning toward a goal. You're quietly ambitious, a little perfectionist, and you light up most when you're useful. The danger is that you start to believe useful is the only way to be loved.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You don't have to earn the warmth you give everyone else.

winter.intro: A candle in winter. Cold all around, so your small flame matters more. You grew up being the warm one in a chilly place, which made you protective, careful, and very good at sensing a mood change from the next room.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You can hear a sigh through a closed door. Through two.

earth.intro: Born in the soil weeks between seasons. Your candle burns into the ground: caring, fixing, holding people together. You make every space feel like home. You also over-give until the wax runs out.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You hosted everyone's crisis. Who's hosting yours?

three-words.heading: Your aura in three words, plus its evil twin
three-words.text:
Good days: warm, intimate, magnetic.

Tired days: guarded, intense, distant.

Yeon: "Intense" is fine at a dinner for two. At a work party it reads as "planning something".

Smile at the room once, early. It lights the candle for everyone.

open.title: You look mysterious in every photo. Even the passport one.
open.text:
You're not the loudest in the room. You're the one people remember on the way home. A look, a quiet comment, a warmth that felt personal.

Bom: You glow up close.

Yeon: You glow up close and look slightly tragic from far away. We'll fix the far away.
open.end: Yeon: Next page: your aura, and why people think you're shy when you're actually just choosing.

cliff.text: Yeon: How people read you, Candle: from far away, | cold. Up close, unforgettable. Most people never get close enough to find out.

sample.text: Your glow-up: send the warmth further than one table. A smile across the room counts.

base.aura:
Your aura is the mountain: grounded, still, quietly strong. People trust you before you've proven anything.

Bom: You look dependable in the best way.

Yeon: You also look unreadable. Neutral face, neutral colours, neutral everything.

Bom: Your glow-up is one point of colour or texture. Something that says there's a person inside the mountain.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: Your aura is a mountain. Calm, grounded, people feel safe near you.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: Your neutral face could hold a press conference. Nobody can tell if you love it or hate it.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: Steady, solid, reassuring. You look like someone who'd know what to do in an emergency.

spring.intro: A mountain in spring, with trees pushing through it from every side. Life tested you early. That's why you're so steady now, and also why "relax" sounds to you like a trick.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You became the calm one because someone had to.

summer.intro: A summer mountain, warmed all the way through. Solid, generous, the one everyone leans on. You give off safety without trying. People tell you things they've never told anyone, and you never repeat them.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: People feel safe with you within five minutes. Rare.

autumn.intro: An autumn mountain, showing its stone. You turn your weight into output: work done, things built, problems quietly solved. You don't talk about feelings much. You show them by fixing the shelf.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Love language: unasked-for repairs. Every time.

winter.intro: A mountain in winter, holding back the river. You manage things: money, plans, other people's chaos. Very good at it. The cost is that you rarely let anything thaw, including you.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You're not cold. You're frozen on purpose. Different.

earth.intro: A mountain born in Earth's own weeks. Triple solid. You don't move unless you want to, and you almost never want to. Your loyalty is legendary. So is the time it takes you to change your mind.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Persuading you is a geological process.

three-words.heading: Your aura in three words, plus its evil twin
three-words.text:
Good days: grounded, calm, trustworthy.

Tired days: heavy, flat, unreachable.

Yeon: "Unreachable" is when the beige wins. Don't let the beige win.

One warm, textured piece near your face. Knit, suede, wood. People will suddenly want to talk to you.

open.title: You're having fun. Your face just runs on battery saver.
open.text:
You give off calm. Grounded. Strong. People feel better standing near you, even if they couldn't say why.

Bom: You make people feel safe.

Yeon: You make people feel safe and slightly worried you're judging their life choices.
open.end: Yeon: Next page: your aura, and the tiny change that turns "solid" into "magnetic".

cliff.text: Yeon: How people read you, Mountain: they think nothing | bothers you. So they say things that bother you. You never correct them.

sample.text: Your glow-up: one point of colour. One. Mountains have wildflowers. Be a mountain with wildflowers.

base.aura:
Your aura is garden soil: warm, soft, welcoming. People feel cared for before you've done anything.

Bom: You make people feel at home.

Yeon: You also dress for practicality first. Comfy shoes, sensible bag, cardigan for emergencies.

Bom: Your glow-up is one thing with no purpose except making you happy.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: Your aura is a garden. Warm, kind, people feel looked after near you.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: Strangers ask you for a tissue. You have one. Of course you have one.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: Gentle, approachable, nurturing. You look like a safe place.

spring.intro: A garden in spring, with everything sprouting from you at once. You grew up being needed: the friend who listens, the kid who helped. Lovely trait. Exhausting default.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You nourish everybody. Your turn next.

summer.intro: Garden soil in summer, warm and rich. You're nurturing on instinct and practical about it: snacks in the bag, charger for everyone, a plan B nobody asked for. Everyone feels a bit safer near you.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You packed plasters for a picnic. Twice.

autumn.intro: A harvest-season garden. Everything you grow, you hand out. Ideas, help, advice, food. The harvest is real, but so is the empty field afterwards, and you never schedule time to grow back.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Giving is your gift. Refilling is your homework.

winter.intro: A winter garden. Frozen on top, busy underneath. You worry productively: lists, backups, a mental spreadsheet of who needs what. You keep it together for everyone, and you'd never admit you're scared too.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You overthink in organised folders. Colour-coded.

earth.intro: Soil born in soil weeks. Double Earth. You're the steady one, the reliable one, the one who remembers birthdays. You can also absorb other people's moods like a sponge and call it "being supportive".

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Their mood, your weekend. Every time.

three-words.heading: Your aura in three words, plus its evil twin
three-words.text:
Good days: warm, caring, real.

Tired days: frazzled, invisible, frumpy.

Yeon: Sorry. I said it. "Frumpy" is what happens when every item has a job.

Wear one thing that has no job at all. Earrings. A colour. A scent. It's for you.

open.title: You look like you have plasters in your bag. You have three kinds.
open.text:
People trust you on sight. You look kind, practical, someone who'd notice if they were upset. You would. You already have.

Bom: You look like comfort.

Yeon: You look like comfort and a backup charger. Which is great, until people only see the charger.
open.end: Yeon: Next page: your aura, and why "nice" is not the word you want people leaving with.

cliff.text: Yeon: How people read you, Field: "so nice". Which is | lovely, and also the word people use right before they forget to invite you.

sample.text: Your glow-up: one useless, beautiful thing a day. No practical purpose allowed.

base.aura:
Your aura is the sword: clean, sharp, unbothered. People read you as strong and honest before you speak.

Bom: You look like you'd keep a promise.

Yeon: You also look like you'd keep a grudge. The jaw does a lot.

Bom: Your glow-up is softness at the edges. A rounder neckline, a warm tone, an easy laugh.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: Your aura is a blade. Clear, strong, people feel protected near you.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: People assume you're annoyed. You're just listening with your eyebrows.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: Sharp lines, strong posture, no fuss. You look like someone who means what they say.

spring.intro: A blade born in spring, surrounded by things to cut. You see what needs doing and you do it, preferably before anyone has finished explaining. Efficient. Also sometimes the reason the meeting went badly.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You solved their problem. They wanted a hug. Classic.

summer.intro: A sword forged in summer. Heat everywhere, so you were shaped by pressure: deadlines, expectations, people who pushed. It made you strong and principled. It also made you assume love is a test you can fail.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You don't have to pass anything. You're already loved.

autumn.intro: A sword born in autumn, metal's own season. Double steel. Loyal to the bone, blunt as a brick, and fair in a way that scares people. You'd fight anyone for a friend, and tell that friend exactly where they went wrong on the way home.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You'd take a bullet for a friend. Then critique their aim.

winter.intro: A blade in winter. Cold, clear, and sharpened by thinking. You say less than other Swords, but when you speak it lands like a verdict. People quote you back to yourself years later.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Your words stay with people. Choose the kind ones too.

earth.intro: A sword still in the stone. Born in the soil weeks, so you were held, fed and protected before you were ever swung. That gives you patience most Swords lack, and a stubborn streak made of actual rock.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Patient, until you're not. Then it's a sword.

three-words.heading: Your aura in three words, plus its evil twin
three-words.text:
Good days: strong, clear, loyal.

Tired days: harsh, closed, combative.

Yeon: "Combative" is just you tired with your arms crossed. Uncross them. Instant upgrade.

Laugh early in any new room. It tells people the blade is friendly.

open.title: Your resting face has opinions. Loud ones.
open.text:
You look strong. Direct. Like someone who'd step in if something went wrong. People sit up straighter around you without knowing why.

Bom: You look protective.

Yeon: You look protective and like you might fight the waiter. You won't. Probably.
open.end: Yeon: Next page: your aura, and how to stop scaring people who actually like you.

cliff.text: Yeon: How people read you, Sword: intimidating. Then they | get to know you and realise you're a soft idiot with a strong jaw.

sample.text: Your glow-up: soften one edge. A colour, a fabric, a laugh. The sword stays sharp. It just stops scaring the waiter.

base.aura:
Your aura is the jewel: bright, clean, refined. People notice you for your details: the ring, the cut, the way it all fits.

Bom: You make people want to dress up.

Yeon: You also make people feel slightly underdressed. In a hoodie. At a barbecue.

Bom: Your glow-up is one relaxed thing. Let people see you can be undone and still be you.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: Your aura is a jewel. Polished, refined, people notice the details.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: You can tell if someone ironed. From across the street.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: Elegant, precise, considered. You look like you have taste, because you do.

spring.intro: A jewel born in spring. Everything was growing and you noticed all of it: what's pretty, what's off, what's three millimetres crooked. You have taste. You also have opinions about other people's taste.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You judged the font on their birthday card. Silently.

summer.intro: A jewel in summer heat. Pressure shaped you: to look good, do well, never be the embarrassing one. You're polished and impressive. One careless comment can still ruin your whole week.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You're allowed to be unfinished. It's charming, honestly.

autumn.intro: A jewel born in metal's own season. Double shine. High standards, sharp eye, zero patience for sloppy. You're the friend people dress up for. You're also the friend people are slightly scared to disappoint.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You're a five-star review. With a long comment section.

winter.intro: A jewel in winter water, washed clear. Your mind is quick and your words are precise. You can say one sentence that fixes everything, or one that ends everything. Most of the time you know which.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You see people so clearly. Use it to be kind.

earth.intro: A jewel still in the earth. Born in the soil weeks, so you were protected, maybe a little over-protected. You need to feel safe before you sparkle, and that's not a flaw. It's quality control.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You need three green flags before one selfie.

three-words.heading: Your aura in three words, plus its evil twin
three-words.text:
Good days: polished, elegant, luminous.

Tired days: stiff, anxious, untouchable.

Yeon: "Untouchable" sounds glamorous. It mostly means nobody talks to you at the party.

One undone detail. Messy hair, rolled sleeves, bare face once. It makes the rest look effortless instead of armoured.

open.title: You noticed their scuffed shoes. You'll never mention it. You'll never forget it.
open.text:
You look put together. Considered. Every detail picked. People assume you woke up like this. You did not wake up like this.

Bom: You make polish look easy.

Yeon: You make polish look easy and then change your earrings three times in the car.
open.end: Yeon: Next page: your aura, and why the most magnetic thing about you is the bit you keep hiding.

cliff.text: Yeon: How people read you, Jewel: perfect. Which means | nobody believes you ever struggle, and you've made sure of it.

sample.text: Your glow-up: one undone detail. Perfect is a display case. Slightly undone is a person.

base.aura:
You read as open water: deep, fluid, a bit unpredictable. People sense range. You could be anyone, anywhere.

Bom: You draw people in with curiosity.

Yeon: You also change your style every three weeks. People can't keep up. You can't either.

Bom: Your glow-up is one constant. A piece, a colour, a scent that's always you, wherever you are.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: Your aura is the ocean. Deep, free, a little mysterious.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: You look like you have a passport in every jacket. Honestly, you might.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: Fluid, curious, magnetic. You look like someone with stories.

spring.intro: The ocean in spring, pouring itself into everything that grows. You're full of ideas and you give them away: plans, pep talks, 3am theories. People feel bigger around you. You sometimes feel emptier after.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You make people feel possible. Keep a little for you.

summer.intro: The ocean in summer, chasing everything. Big appetite for life: trips, people, projects, the next thing. You're magnetic and hard to pin down. Being pinned down is honestly your nightmare.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You said "let's see where it goes". You meant "don't make me commit".

autumn.intro: The ocean in autumn, fed by every stream. Deep, informed, a little too clever. You absorb everything and you can talk your way out of anything. That includes your own feelings.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You intellectualise heartbreak. With footnotes.

winter.intro: The ocean in winter. Double water. Deep, cold on top, enormous underneath. You need a lot of freedom and you think in huge loops. People call you mysterious. You just haven't decided yet.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Your depth scares shallow people. That's their problem.

earth.intro: An ocean held by cliffs. Born in the soil weeks, so you grew up with banks and rules around you. It gave you focus. It also left you with a quiet itch to flood something just to prove you can.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You follow every rule. Until one random Tuesday.

three-words.heading: Your aura in three words, plus its evil twin
three-words.text:
Good days: deep, free, captivating.

Tired days: scattered, absent, unreadable.

Yeon: "Absent" is when your body's at dinner and your brain is in Lisbon.

Pick one constant and keep it for a season. Constants make free look chosen.

open.title: You always look like you're about to leave for an airport.
open.text:
You look interesting. Like someone who's been somewhere and is about to go somewhere else. People want to ask you questions.

Bom: You look free.

Yeon: You look free and like you haven't decided what you're wearing tomorrow. Or where you'll live.
open.end: Yeon: Next page: your aura, and the one thing that makes all that freedom look intentional.

cliff.text: Yeon: How people read you, Ocean: fascinating, and | about to disappear. They hold back because they think you're leaving.

sample.text: Your glow-up: one constant. Wear the same thing on purpose for a month. Mystery needs a signature.

base.aura:
Your aura is soft rain: calm, cool, a little mysterious. People feel peaceful near you.

Bom: You make people feel safe enough to be quiet.

Yeon: You also blend in. Soft colours, soft voice, soft exit.

Bom: Your glow-up is one clear note. A bold lip, a sharp coat, something that says "I'm here" before you speak.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: Your aura is rain. Soft, dreamy, people feel calm near you.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: People forget you're in the room. Then they can't stop thinking about you on the way home.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: Gentle, intuitive, a little otherworldly. You look like you know things.

spring.intro: Spring rain. You feed everything around you without anyone noticing it was you. You sense moods, fix vibes, water other people's plants. Quietly essential. Quietly forgotten. Not anymore.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Everything grows a little when you're around.

summer.intro: Rain in summer, gone the moment it lands. You chase what you want in quiet, clever ways, and you vanish when a room gets too loud. People find you fascinating. They also never quite know where you went.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You left the party without saying bye. Again. Iconic.

autumn.intro: Autumn rain, fed by cool clean air. Intuitive to the point of spooky. You know who's lying, who's sad, and who's about to text before your phone even lights up.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Your gut is right more often than your decisions are.

winter.intro: Winter rain. Double water. Still, deep, mostly internal. You feel everything at full volume and show about four percent of it. Your notes app has more emotional range than most novels.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Your quiet isn't empty. It's full.

earth.intro: Rain falling on hard ground. Born in the soil weeks, so you met walls early: rules, expectations, people who didn't get you. You learned to soak in slowly instead of crashing through. Patient. Persistent. Underrated.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You don't fight walls. You just wear them down. Over years.

three-words.heading: Your aura in three words, plus its evil twin
three-words.text:
Good days: dreamy, calm, intriguing.

Tired days: faded, distant, overlooked.

Yeon: "Overlooked" isn't a personality. It's a lighting problem.

One clear note per outfit. Something with an edge. Rain can be a storm when it wants.

open.title: You say one sentence and the whole room turns around.
open.text:
You're not the first person people notice. You're the one they keep thinking about. Quiet, soft, a bit dreamy.

Bom: You have a gentle glow.

Yeon: You have a gentle glow and the volume set to two.
open.end: Yeon: Next page: your aura, and how to be seen without becoming someone you're not.

cliff.text: Yeon: How people read you, Rain: "sweet" and "quiet". Then | they hear what you actually think and realise they had no idea.

sample.text: Your glow-up: one clear, bold note per outfit. You're allowed to be noticed on purpose.
